unit.why: A single narrative about the Besht saving a disciple from a heavenly decree caused by another disciple's grievance over taking snuff during Rosh Hashanah prayer.

stories.start_quote: כמו ששמעתי מחמי הה״ק מוהר״ר אברהם מרדכי
stories.end_quote: ועי׳ נוצר חסד אבות פ״ר. (א״ה פ׳ קדושים)
stories.summary_en: A disciple resents his fellow for stopping mid-prayer on Rosh Hashanah to pick up and take snuff, which brings a death decree on the fellow; the Besht ascends to heaven and arranges that if the accuser finds merit himself the decree is annulled, takes away the accuser's mental clarity so that he muses on the mystical purpose of tobacco and regrets, and on Hoshana Rabbah reveals all and warns him always to judge favourably.
